feeds.title: British Wrestling
feeds.description: British Wrestling (BWA) is the National Governing Body for wrestling in the UK, including the Olympic and Commonwealth styles of wrestling and other styles within the remit of United World Wrestling, as well as other indigenous forms of wrestling. Stay up to date with the latest news and updates on wrestling sports, events, tournaments, wrestlers and more!

feeds.title: WrestleTalk

feeds.title: Scottish Wrestling Network
feeds.description: I am Billy Strachan. I love wrestling, and support wrestling in this country. I have been a wrestling fan for about 25 years, 10 of which I've been engrossed by Scottish wrestling. The site covers everything on Scottish Professional Wrestling including news, views, reviews and interviews.

feeds.title: Wrestling Research Blog
feeds.description: Modern progressive British professional companies and training schools might be broadly committed to caring for wrestlers' wellbeing, but there has been no research on the most appropriate methods of care, or the stresses this unique art-sport places on mind and body. This collaborative, interdisciplinary project tackles this by conducting a supportive health check of British wrestling in a global context. Explore the latest research, initiatives, news and more!
